checks.text: The page shows the heading "Music Metronome", a field labelled "BPM" with the value "120", a select labelled "Time signature" with the value "4/4", a button "Start", and a button "Save preset".
Typing "90" in the field labelled "BPM" changes the displayed BPM to "90" and the interval display to "667 ms".
Clicking the button "Start" changes the button label to "Stop" and the status text to "Running".
With the metronome running, clicking the button "Stop" changes the button label to "Start" and the status text to "Stopped".

With the field labelled "BPM" set to "120" and the field labelled "Preset name" set to "Jazz", clicking the button "Save preset" adds a list item containing "Jazz" and "120 BPM" and shows the toast "Preset saved".
With the list item "Jazz 120 BPM" present, clicking the button "Delete Jazz" removes that item from the list.
Selecting "3/4" in the select labelled "Time signature" changes the beat counter display to show "1 / 3" on the first beat of the next cycle.
The tab labelled "Presets" shows the list of saved presets; after saving "Jazz" at 120 BPM, switching to the tab labelled "Presets" shows a list item containing "Jazz" and "120 BPM".
Reload keeps the saved preset: after saving "Jazz" at 120 BPM and reloading the page, the tab labelled "Presets" still shows a list item containing "Jazz" and "120 BPM".
